answer: Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 4 epochs, which means holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in whisper and jade lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the saffron graph. A farm of 2442 identities would post 1989 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
